title: 骸鉄の軌跡：終焉を運ぶ列車
author: 鉄 ハガネ

prediction.question: ルナを救うために何を選ぶ？

en.title: Traces of Corpse Iron: The Train of Demise
en.premise: In an era where 'meaning' has vanished from the world and a plague of thoughtlessness ravages humanity, I journey alongside the only girl capable of preserving memories. Our goal: the 'Final Train,' the key to rebooting the world. We must traverse 'Underground Libraries' where forgotten knowledge lies dormant, carving a path through former comrades who have succumbed to madness. This is a journey of blood and iron, meant to drive hope into the very heart of despair.

zh.title: 骸铁轨迹：运送终焉的列车
zh.premise: 这是一个“意义”从世界中消失，人们被丧失思考能力的疾病所侵蚀的时代。我带着唯一能够保留记忆的少女，目标是寻找能够实现世界重启的“最终列车”。途中，我们巡游着沉睡着被遗忘知识的“地下图书馆”，斩杀那些丧失理智的昔日战友，不断前行。这是一段为了在绝望尽头强行夺回希望，而展开的鲜血与钢铁的旅程。
